instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot, low angle. In a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio with white walls and a light gray floor, two girls perform floor exercises. In the foreground, the blonde girl in a beige long-sleeve top and shorts (R5) bends forward with her hands on the floor, hips raised high, and her right leg extended backward. Behind her to the right, the light brown-haired girl in a beige crop top and shorts (R2) is in a similar bent-over crawling posture with hands and feet on the floor. The room is filled with soft, diffused natural light, emphasizing the clean, neutral beige and gray color palette.
